name: houge_status
description: Houge's own runtime, read-only: daemon pid, start time and uptime, why it last booted (self-write reload, kickstart, revive, crash recovery), the git HEAD and dist build it is running (and whether the build is stale), the last merged self-write, the omp version and planner/reader models, open incidents, breaker headroom and kill/park/disarm state. Call it before answering any question about whether you restarted, which code is live, or your own health; never ask Paco to check these for you.
